about: mock: the junior SWE scenario's floor (server started with AGENT_IDE_MOCK=junior; workspace/fixtures/junior-swe/FIXTURE.md), within ten minutes of the server's start (later, its columns have folded to stubs). Sends nothing to any agent. Covers: the four connector islands with their vendor marks (Slack, Google Drive, Linear by claude.ai UUID; GitHub by name from Codex), the Drive island's sheet with its tools and counts, the rail rewound to the start (before the first Drive call) and played back until the Drive search's courier is out, then back to now and the Claude Code column focused with its MCP blocks carrying connector marks and beams to the islands.

actions.note: the time rail is hidden by default on a live floor (2026-11-13): its icon shows it

actions.log: the four islands, each with its vendor mark (connectors.json names the UUIDs)

actions.note: brand colours: every island's mark in its brand's own colour at rest (GitHub the ink-grey), none black

actions.log: the islands stand in a stack beside the floor's right edge, outside its footprint, over no column (2026-11-06)

actions.note: brand colours: a hovered island's mark keeps its colour (only its alpha goes up); the others unchanged

actions.log: the Drive island's sheet lists search_files and read_file_content with their counts
rewind to the start (before the first Drive call) and play back at 5x until the Drive search's courier (the Claude Code column's fourth MCP call) is out

actions.waitFor: courier:RCP-142: receipt totals a cent off:3

actions.note: the courier teal (motion), the Drive island still in its brand colour, at full alpha while the call is out

actions.log: focus the junior's Claude Code column: its MCP blocks carry the Slack, Drive and Linear marks, with beams to the islands

a block carries its connector's mark only when it is tall enough for its icon (ICON_PX, 14 px); since 9cf89559e (2026-11-09, one shared context scale) a focused column is framed up to its compaction point (967k for this Claude Code session), so its MCP blocks stand 1-2 px high at focus: zoom in on the column until they are tall enough

actions.note: brand colours: the blocks' connector glyphs in their brands' colours, none black
